name: The reading text, eight topics
note: 80 chunks of about 400 words of MEL's reading text (commit 35c6cd8), cut within chapters; the bench's stopwords (167); minimum word length 3, minimum count 2. Topics 2–5, 7 and 8 recur in all four other seeds, topic 1 in three, topic 6 in one. Read topic 6 with caution. The reading text is MEL's edition, not Melville's last state of the manuscript.
